assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent character animation pose for a warm illustrated small theater. Input image is the identity and style reference for the golden patched moon. Generate one different acting pose of exactly this moon character. It is suddenly hiccuping: large startled open eyes rather than closed smiling eyes, inflated cheeks and a small round O mouth, little arms startled outward. Keep the full round golden cratered body, same lavender upper-left patch and amber lower-right patch with dark cobalt sewn stitches, same warm watercolor and crayon paper texture and rough dark ink outlines. The small rip on the right edge leaks one or two attached tiny golden stars; keep the dark blue torn interior. The pose must read as surprised and funny, visibly different from the happy laughing reference, while preserving the same character identity. Composition: single complete centered character, generous clear margin on all sides, nothing cropped. Background: genuine alpha transparency, no backdrop, no ground shadow or paper rectangle. No other characters, cats, fish, typography, watermark, or border. Preserve hand-painted look, not smooth vector or 3D.
assets.visualQA: passed: preserved golden round moon, sewn lavender and amber patches, rustic crayon/watercolor texture; wide eyes and round mouth clearly differ from laughing pose; complete uncut subject with alpha background.
